why: Issue #936. The wide states-by-layouts template is right at TV width and wrong below it. MEASURED on the full 49x9 page: a cell is 92px at 1920, 20px at 1280, and the page overflows a 390px viewport sideways (443 against 390). With the fallback the same page gives 157px at 1280 and 262px at 390 and scrolls in one axis at both. A media query whose condition can never match is the shape this would take if someone 'simplified' the breakpoint, and it leaves every non-TV reviewer a page of 20px thumbnails.
killedBy: renderIndexPage: the page a reviewer opens stops being a 9-column grid below TV width, and names the layout in the cell instead
